Our department operates as a unified regional group across both sites. Successful candidates will provide perioperative care across our diverse clinical slates, out-of-operating-room services, and on-call coverage. Subspecialty interest or fellowship training in neuroanesthesia, cardiac anesthesia, regional anesthesia/acute pain, high-risk obstetric anesthesia, or perioperative medicine is considered an asset. Other fellowships may be considered. Academic Affiliation: Clinical Faculty Appointments with the University of British Columbia (UBC) & Simon Fraser University (SFU) School of Medicine Academic Role, Teaching & Research Opportunities As a designated teaching site affiliated with both UBC and the SFU School of Medicine, successful candidates will be eligible for clinical faculty appointments. Teaching Expectations: There is an active expectation of teaching and mentoring medical learners, including residents and medical students, in both bedside clinical workflows and structured academic environments. Research & Scholarly Inquiry: Candidates will have opportunities to participate in or lead clinical research, departmental quality improvement (QI) initiatives, and multicentre clinical trials aligned with their interests and expertise. About The Department And Sites Comprising over 50 physicians, our common department provides comprehensive perioperative, critical care, and acute pain services across two complementary tertiary and community environments: Royal Columbian Hospital (RCH): Located 20 minutes outside Vancouver, RCH is a premier Level 1 adult trauma and tertiary referral centre affiliated with UBC and SFU. It is the only hospital in British Columbia offering trauma, cardiac surgery, neurosurgery, high-risk obstetrics, neonatal intensive care, and acute mental health care on a single site. The multi-phase RCH Redevelopment Project is currently transforming the campus with state-of-the-art operative suites, expanded interventional capacity, and advanced critical care facilities. Eagle Ridge Hospital (ERH): Situated in nearby Port Moody, ERH is a vibrant community hospital delivering high-volume elective and day surgical programs, regional rehabilitation, and 24/7 emergency services. Members of our department rotate through ERH as part of our integrated regional practice. Our team fosters a highly supportive, collaborative culture dedicated to clinical excellence, resident and undergraduate medical education, and departmental wellness Qualifications & Requirements Fellow of the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada (FRCPC) in Anesthesiology, or eligible for FRCPC certification. Eligible for full, independent licensure with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of British Columbia (CPSBC). Eligibility for clinical faculty appointment with UBC and SFU. Post-residency fellowship training or demonstrated equivalent clinical expertise in a relevant subspecialty (or willingness to obtain fellowship training). Open to all qualified Canadian and International Medical Graduates eligible for British Columbia licensure. About Fraser Health Fraser Health is the heart of health care for over two million people in Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley in British Columbia, Canada, on the traditional, ancestral and unceded lands of the Coast Salish and Nlaka’pamux Nations and is home to 32 First Nations within the Fraser Salish region. People - those we care for and those who care for them - are at the heart of everything we do. Our hospital and community-based services are delivered by a team of 50,000+ staff, medical staff and volunteers. We are committed to planetary health and value diversity in the work force. We strive to maintain an environment of respect, caring and trust. Fraser Health’s hiring practices aspire to ensure all individuals are treated in an inclusive, equitable and culturally safe manner. Together, we are the heart of health care. Request Info Terms Compensation Compensation Type Alternative Payment Arrangement Request Info

review_candidates.description: About the Role We are looking for an experienced Accounting Supervisor with a strong accounting background and a CPA qualification to lead the daily accounting operations of our Chile subsidiary, ensuring the accuracy and timeliness of monthly closing, financial reporting, and tax filings. The ideal candidate should be proficient in SAP financial modules, familiar with Chilean local accounting standards and tax requirements, and have experience in the automotive industry or multinational companies. Responsibilities 1. Accounting & Month-End Closing Responsible for full-cycle accounting of the Chile subsidiary, ensuring accuracy and compliance. Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual closing processes to ensure timely completion. Prepare and review accounting vouchers, general ledger, sub-ledgers, and financial statements. Manage fixed assets, inventory, AR/AP, expense accruals, and other accounting areas. Ensure accounting treatment complies with Chilean local accounting standards (NIF/IFRS) and group accounting policies. 2. SAP System Operation & Maintenance Proficient in SAP FI/CO modules for daily accounting and system operations. Participate in SAP implementation, upgrade, or optimization projects, supporting configuration and testing. Maintain SAP master data (accounts, vendors, customers, etc.) to ensure data accuracy. Use SAP reporting tools to generate management reports and analytical data. 3. Financial Reporting Issue Chilean subsidiary statutory financial statements and management reports on time. Prepare monthly business analysis reports and report financial results to headquarters and local management. Support group consolidation by providing required reporting data. Support internal and external audits by providing required materials and explanations. 4. Tax Management Responsible for Chilean monthly, quarterly, and annual tax filings (IVA, income tax, withholding tax, etc.). Ensure tax treatment complies with Chilean Internal Revenue Service (SII) requirements, completing filings and payments on time. Manage tax vouchers and archives, and support tax audits and inspections. Monitor changes in Chilean tax regulations, assess their impact on the company, and provide recommendations. Maintain communication with external tax advisors to ensure tax compliance. 5. Internal Controls & Process Optimization Establish and maintain accounting-related internal control processes. Identify risk points in accounting and tax processes and propose improvements. Drive standardization and automation of accounting processes to improve efficiency. Support headquarters in internal control testing and compliance reviews. 6. Team Management Lead and manage the local accounting team, assigning tasks and supervising execution. Train team members to enhance overall professional capabilities. Coordinate communication and collaboration with other departments. Qualifications Education : Bachelor's degree or above in Accounting . Qualification : Certified Public Accountant (CPA) or equivalent professional qualification. Experience : 10+ years of accounting experience, including at least 3 years in a supervisory or team management role. Required Skills SAP : Proficient in SAP FI/CO modules, familiar with month-end closing and reporting. Accounting Standards : Familiar with Chilean local accounting standards (NIF) and IFRS. Tax Experience : Experience in Chilean tax filing and management, familiar with SII requirements. Language : English sufficient for daily work communication. Skills : Proficient in Excel, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Preferred Skills Experience in the automotive industry or multinational companies is preferred. Experience in SAP implementation or migration projects is a plus. Experience at a Big Four accounting firm is a plus. Familiarity with Chilean local tax regulations and filing systems is a plus. Required Skills (Key Competencies) Professional Qualification : Accounting background with CPA or equivalent. SAP Operation : Proficient in SAP FI/CO, able to independently handle daily accounting and month-end closing. Month-End Closing : Familiar with the full closing process, able to complete closing and reporting efficiently and accurately. Financial Reporting : Able to independently prepare statutory and management reports with accurate data. Tax Management : Familiar with Chilean tax filing processes, able to handle daily tax matters. Communication : Able to communicate effectively with headquarters, local teams, and external advisors. Time Management : Able to complete multiple tasks with high quality before deadlines.

review_candidates.description: Position Overview The Accountant is responsible for managing the complete accounts receivable and accounts payable cycles, ensuring accurate financial records, compliance with UAE VAT and Corporate Tax regulations, and timely financial reporting. The role requires strong experience with Odoo ERP, excellent reconciliation skills, and the ability to support month-end and year-end closing activities while maintaining effective internal controls. Key Responsibilities: Accounts Receivable (AR) Manage day-to-day AR operations in Odoo ERP, including customer invoicing, payment posting, reconciliations, and AR-related journal entries. Prepare and maintain accurate customer ledgers, statements of account, and AR records. Monitor outstanding receivables, conduct regular follow-ups, and ensure timely collections. Reconcile AR balances with bank statements and ensure all receipts are accurately recorded. Generate AR aging reports, analyze collection trends, and provide collection status updates and forecasts to management. Investigate and resolve customer billing discrepancies and payment disputes. Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing by preparing AR schedules and reconciliations. Ensure accurate VAT treatment on sales invoices and provide AR documentation for VAT returns, UAE Corporate Tax filings, and external audits.    Accounts Payable (AP) Review, verify, and process supplier invoices, purchase orders, goods receipt notes (GRNs), and payment requests in Odoo ERP. Perform three-way matching (PO, GRN, Invoice) to ensure accuracy before posting transactions. Process vendor payments through bank transfers, cheques, and online payment methods. Maintain vendor ledgers and master data, reconcile supplier statements, and resolve invoice discrepancies. Monitor AP aging and ensure payments are made within agreed credit terms. Ensure accurate VAT treatment on supplier invoices and provide AP documentation for VAT returns, UAE Corporate Tax filings, and audit requirements. General Accounting & Compliance Generate AR and AP financial reports from Odoo ERP and provide insights to support management decision-making. Assist with budgeting, cash flow forecasting, and expected collection/payment schedules. Ensure compliance with UAE accounting standards, VAT regulations, Corporate Tax requirements, and company policies. Support internal and external audits by preparing reconciliations, confirmations, and supporting documentation. Maintain strong internal controls and ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of all financial records and transactions. Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree in Bachelor of Science in Accountancy (BSA) or an equivalent accounting qualification. Minimum of 3 years of accounting experience in the UAE . Strong knowledge of UAE VAT, Corporate Tax, and IFRS. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP systems, preferably Odoo . Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines.

review_candidates.description: الملخص متجر Apple Retail هو المكان الذي يجتمع فيه أفضل ما تقدمه Apple. حيث نكرس خبرتنا لمساعدة الأشخاص على فعل ما يحبون، مقدمين تجربة فريدة لا تجدها إلا في Apple. في Apple، نؤمن بأن الشمولية مسؤولية مشتركة، ونعمل معاً لتعزيز ثقافة يشعر فيها الجميع بالانتماء والدافع لتقديم أفضل ما لديهم. بصفتك مختص دعم تقني، فإنك تقدم الدعم التقني وتتمتع بمهارات عالية في استكشاف الأخطاء وإصلاحها لجميع العملاء، مع تعزيز الحماس تجاه منتجات Apple وخدماتها. كما أنك تلتزم بتقديم خدمة استثنائية للعملاء، ما يتيح لهم الاستفادة من منتجات Apple إلى أقصى حد. يحرص مختص الدعم التقني على توعية العملاء بخيارات الإصلاح ومنتجات Apple وخدماتها. وصف الوظيفة تطوير المعرفة بمنتجات Apple وخدماتها، بالإضافة إلى عمليات وإجراءات الإصلاح في Genius Bar والاطلاع على آخر المستجدات، لدعم عمليات الإصلاح الفعّالة وعالية الجودة. دعم العملاء الذين يواجهون مشكلات في منتجات Apple أو برامجها بعناية واهتمام، مع الاستفادة من جميع الأدوات والموارد التي توفرها Apple. استكشاف الأخطاء وتشخيصها وحل مشكلات الخدمة المتعلقة بأجهزة وبرمجيات Apple المحددة. العمل مع قادة الفريق لتحديد مشكلات الإصلاح المتكررة ومخاوف الخدمة الأخرى، والتأكد من تقديم الملاحظات إلى Apple. تقديم خدمة ممتازة لعملاء Apple من خلال السعي لفهم احتياجاتهم، وتحديد فرص التملك، وتقديم توصيات للمنتجات والخدمات، وتثقيفهم حول أفضل طرق الشراء. أداء مهام أخرى بحسب الحاجة، بما في ذلك على سبيل المثال لا الحصر، دعم الأنشطة التي تشمل التعامل مباشرة مع العملاء سواء داخل قاعة المبيعات أو خارجها. المساهمة في توفير بيئة تتميز بالشمولية من خلال احترام التنوع والتحلي بالفضول الذي يشجع على التعلم. إظهار قيم Apple المتعلقة بالشمول والتنوع في الأنشطة اليومية. المؤهلات المطلوبة أن تكون متاحاً للعمل وفقاً لجدول يتماشى مع احتياجات العمل، وقد يشمل ذلك العمل في فترات ليلية وعطلات نهاية الأسبوع والعطلات الرسمية في متجر البيع بالتجزئة، وأن تلتزم بالحضور إلى مكان العمل وفق الجدول المحدد، بما يتماشى مع القوانين المحلية وأي تسهيلات معتمدة. يجب عليك أيضاً أن تتقن اللغة المحلية كتابة ونطقاً. المؤهلات المُفضَّلة يمكنك: إظهار الخبرة التقنية بمنتجات Apple وخدماتها. اتباع خطوات استكشاف الأخطاء لتحديد السبب الجذري للمشكلة التقنية في بيئة خدمة العملاء. التعامل مع مشاكل خدمة العملاء بعناية وبمهارات تواصل شخصي قوية. التعرف باستمرار على منتجات Apple وخدماتها، بالإضافة إلى منتجات الجهات الخارجية وتعميق معرفتك بها، لتحسين تجربة العملاء. العمل في بيئة سريعة الوتيرة مع القدرة على تحقيق التوازن بين المهام المتعددة في الوقت ذاته. العمل في بيئة أساسها الفريق، مع إظهار المسؤولية المشتركة والمحاسبة تجاه أعضاء الفريق الآخرين. أن تكون محل ثقة في التعامل مع المعلومات الحساسة أو السرية، مع الالتزام بقيم Apple الأساسية. التحلي بالفضول والانفتاح على التعلم من الآخرين ودعم نمو الجميع. في Apple، لدى كل منا مهارات مختلفة، وهذا أهم أسباب قوتنا. نرى أن الاختلافات في هويتنا، وما اختبرناه في حياتنا، وطريقة تفكيرنا - جميعها عناصر تُثري عملنا. لأننا نؤمن بأنه، حتى نتمكن من ابتكار منتجات تخدم الجميع، لا بُد من إشراك الجميع. ولهذا، نُعامل المرشحين كافة بعدلٍ ومساواة. سنتعاون مع المرشحين لتوفير التسهيلات المناسبة لهم. نؤمن في Apple بأن تسهيلات الاستخدام هي حق أصيل لكل إنسان. ستجد أن هذه الفكرة تتجلى في كل شيء هنا، بداية من ثقافتنا ومزايانا الوظيفية وحتى أدواتنا الرقمية. ولأننا نُرحب بجميع وجهات النظر على تعددها، نساعدك على بناء مسيرة مهنية تشعر فيها بالانتماء. تعرّف على تسهيلات الاستخدام التي توفرها Apple في مكان العمل Role Number: 200598710

review_candidates.title: Technical Uptime Specialist
review_candidates.description: Company Profile With over 80 years of innovation, JCB is the world’s largest privately owned manufacturer of construction and agricultural equipment. Operating 23 manufacturing facilities across four continents—including the United States, the United Kingdom, India, and Brazil—JCB produces a diverse portfolio of more than 300 products. These include telescopic handlers, backhoe loaders, excavators, wheel loaders, compact excavators, skid steer loaders, compact track loaders, access aerial work platforms, rough terrain forklifts, and tractors. At the heart of JCB’s success are its people. As a family-owned business, we are accountable to our customers—not shareholders—which gives us the flexibility to focus on long-term innovation and delivering real value. This independence allows us to continuously develop advanced technologies and integrate them into equipment designed to perform in the toughest environments while maximizing customer productivity. At JCB, we stand behind our products—and our name—with pride and commitment to quality. Position Purpose Reporting to the North American Service Manager, this position is responsible for providing ongoing technical diagnostic support to customers on JCB product lines and management of the uptime of machine product ranges and fleets. Position Type Full Time, Exempt Location Onsite in San Antonio, TX Benefits And Other Compensation JCB offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401 (k) retirement plan; paid time off and paid holidays. Application Process Applications will be accepted through Careers | JCB Careers | JCB Jobs | JCB or via LinkedIn. The anticipated application window will close on October 23, 2026. Major Tasks, Responsibilities & Key Accountabilities Ensure fast and accurate responses to all dealer technical diagnostic concerns; either by way of online, written responses or telephone communication. Maintain detailed call logs for all customer enquiries & requests for assistance, including closing details and date. Use latest machine monitoring software to monitor fleet health and action accordingly. Support customer business by way of documentation of product concerns, liaising with internal quality teams and supporting investigations and ensuring concerns are handled promptly and efficiently. Additionally, supporting the creation of communication of solutions to the field using multiple media (for example written service instructions, help videos). Key role in New Product Introduction, ensuring market readiness within the Service function. This includes reporting to customers and other relevant parties on new model design as it affects Service. Host customers and corporate visits while communicating business strategies and key activities. Other duties as assigned Minimum Qualifications Ability to read hydraulic and electrical schematics Previous employment as a technician on CE/AG equipment, ideally in a customer facing role. Must pass any drug screens, background checks, and any pre-employment tests, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable law. Preferred Qualifications Technical Institute graduate in related field 7+ years of technical service or training experience within a related industry Knowledge, Skills, Abilities & Competencies Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Ability to work in a high-stress environment. Detail-oriented and able to work independently. Collaborative approach to resolving issues impacting various groups across the enterprise. Ability to understand processes (system and non-system), troubleshoot, develop, and recommend solutions. Enjoy working in a dynamic environment and be a self-motivated team player. Working knowledge of Microsoft Office products, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and Microsoft Project. Job Conditions Both office environment and occasionally manufacturing/factory environment. Subject to noise and temperature changes. Physical Requirements The physical demands described here are representative of those required of an employee to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to: Remain stationary, operate hands to finger, handle, or feel, reach with hands and arms, and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand and move and/or walk. The employee must frequently move and/or transport up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Equal Opportunity Employer JCB is an equal employment opportunity (EEO) employer in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. JCB complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment at every location where the company has facilities. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability statute, or any other characteristic protected under federal, state, and local laws. EEO EMPLOYER/VET/DISABLED. Reasonable Accommodation Statement JCB complies with federal and state disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact the JCB Human Resources team at hrsupport@jcb.com. JCB Inc. is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, JCB offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S., which can be found through our website at https://www.jcb.com/en-gb/about/careers. Disclaimer: This job description is general in nature and is not designed to contain or to be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to the job.

review_candidates.description: ShipTime & Paid Inc. are innovative SaaS companies that empower small and medium-sized businesses across North America with an all-in-one platform for eCommerce, payment processing, and shipping. Our integrated solutions help businesses streamline operations, reduce costs, and grow with confidence. Through our ShipTime platform, we provide access to preferred shipping rates from leading carriers, including DHL, FedEx, and Purolator, and partner with trusted organizations such as Costco and CFIB to deliver smart, cost-effective shipping solutions. Together, we're transforming the way businesses manage their online presence, payments, and fulfillment. As a key member of our team, you’ll be working within a fast-growing, fun technology company that provides an inspiring environment, a positive culture, and great people! This role combines customer-facing technical support, troubleshooting of our SaaS platform and integrations, and internal IT support. Key Responsibilities Work closely with our Heroic Support team to investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve escalated technical issues. Take ownership of support tickets from initial investigation through resolution, ensuring timely follow-up and clear communication. Independently diagnose issues involving our platform, carrier connections, APIs, and eCommerce integrations. Analyze application logs, API requests/responses, and system behaviour to identify root causes before escalating to Development when necessary. Assist customers and developers through technical calls with API connections, plugins, and integrations. Manage internal IT inventory, company devices, and equipment provisioning for employee onboarding and offboarding. Provide general internal IT support, including hardware, software, and workstation troubleshooting. Utilize GitHub, AI tools, and technical documentation to research issues, improve workflows, and collaborate with Development. Create and maintain troubleshooting guides, technical documentation, and knowledge base articles. Identify recurring issues and proactively recommend improvements to support processes and the customer experience. Qualifications Strong technical troubleshooting and analytical skills, with a demonstrated ability to independently research and solve problems. Excellent communication and customer service skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users. Experience supporting SaaS platforms, web applications, or other software-based products. Familiarity with eCommerce platforms such as Shopify and WooCommerce. Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, HTTP requests, and common integration issues. Familiarity with GitHub and AI-powered tools such as ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or similar solutions. General knowledge of computer hardware, operating systems, and IT troubleshooting. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities. A proactive, accountable, and resourceful mindset, with the initiative to investigate unfamiliar issues and see them through to resolution. Skills 2-5 years experience in Technical Support related roles Excellent English and French verbal and written communication skills Experience with SQL, including querying and investigating database records. Familiarity with Java, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, or other programming languages. Experience with Postman, application logs, or API troubleshooting tools. Experience with IT asset management, equipment provisioning, or employee onboarding/offboarding. Experience with HubSpot, Zendesk, Freshdesk, or similar ticketing platforms. Experience in shipping, logistics, or eCommerce technology. What We Offer We’re in this together - our success relies on working together as a team with other departments and we promote a highly supportive and respectful environment FUN! - You’ll have the opportunity to work each day with fun, passionate individuals. Whether it’s a summer outing or friendly competitive contests there’s always a company event on-going. Engage with customers and partners from across the country, spanning many industries. Benefits Full benefits package (vision, dental, etc.) Paid Vacation Time Company Events On-site parking About The Role Job Type: Full-Time Salary: $50,000-60,000 CAD/year Remote Work: Hybrid

review_candidates.description: Company Description Redecor&More is a team of experienced and innovative contractors and architects specializing in fine finishing for residential and commercial projects. The company supports clients through new construction, home finishing, and renovation, focusing on high-quality results at competitive prices. Its skilled team is equipped to manage fast-track, complex projects while maintaining attention to detail. Redecor&More operates in Egypt and Saudi Arabia, offering opportunities to work on diverse regional developments. Role Description The BIM Lead (Architect) is a full-time, on-site role based in Giza, responsible for leading Building Information Modeling activities across architectural projects. This role oversees the creation, coordination, and management of BIM models, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and alignment with project requirements and standards. The BIM Lead collaborates with architects, engineers, and contractors to integrate design information, resolve clashes, and support efficient project delivery. Daily tasks include guiding the design team in BIM best practices, developing and maintaining BIM templates and libraries, coordinating model updates, and providing technical support and training. The role also involves assisting with project planning, documentation, and reporting to ensure timely completion of high-quality residential and commercial finishing projects. Qualifications Strong background in Architecture and Architectural Design, with experience leading design development in BIM environments. Skills in Software Development and Integration related to BIM tools and workflows, such as custom scripts, plug-ins, or interoperability solutions. Proven Project Management abilities, including planning, coordination, and monitoring of BIM-related tasks across multidisciplinary teams. Proficiency in BIM and CAD software (e.g., Revit, Navisworks, AutoCAD) and familiarity with industry standards and protocols. Bachelor’s degree in Architecture or a related field; advanced certification in BIM is an advantage. Experience in residential and commercial finishing projects, with attention to detail and quality control. Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to guide and mentor team members. Strong problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills, with the capacity to work on fast-track, complex projects.
